item.title: Digital Strategizing: Emerging Forms and Underexplored Contexts
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in the Journal of Strategic Information Systems focuses on digital strategizing, examining new approaches and contexts that have received limited scholarly attention. The issue seeks to advance understanding of how organizations develop and implement strategic approaches in digital environments.
